name: How does BIM support prefabrication and modular construction?

mainEntity.name: How does BIM support prefabrication and modular construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: BIM generates precise shop drawings, cut lists, and assembly sequences for off-site fabrication, ensuring components fit perfectly and reducing on-site labor and waste. autodesk​
